summary: Verification-only Track B phase, the final per-family verification in the current executable schema implementation line. Verifies schemas/repository_intelligence/artifacts/repository_intelligence_package.schema.json implemented in 119AA. Confirms all 20 Repository Intelligence schema files parse as valid JSON, declare JSON Schema Draft 2020-12, have unique $id values, and 477 local $ref occurrences resolve. Verifies shared component reuse, common artifact envelope relationship, package identity, package composition, included artifact records and artifact type enum, package provenance and provenance type enum, integrity disclosure, compatibility claims and compatibility status enum, package index, package summaries, package exclusions, unknowns/gaps, Evidence link structure, boundary disclosures, disclaimers, and additionalProperties false policy. No schema or shared-component corrections required. Explicitly confirms the schema does not generate, validate, build, or register packages, does not compute package integrity, and does not execute queries, traverse graphs, or integrate Advisory. Documents an inherited, non-blocking is_phase_id_backward() phase-id comparison bug in pcae phase complete discovered during 119AA finalization. No new artifact-family schema, validator, CLI, models, extraction, runtime behavior, source code, or test code.
tests_added_or_updated: None. 119AB was verification-only and did not add automated tests.
authority_creep_language_review_result: No risky phrases found in the schema, README, or phase documents.
common_artifact_envelope_relationship: Required envelope property references the verified shared common artifact envelope schema.
package_generation_non_implementation_co: package_provenance.generated_by_future_system and provenance_type both carry in-schema descriptions explicitly disclaiming current PCAE package generation.
package_validation_non_implementation_co: integrity_disclosure represents declared counts and consistency_status only; integrity_type's in-schema description disclaims checksum computation or runtime validation.
package_builder_non_implementation_confi: No field triggers, schedules, or configures package assembly; the schema is declarative structure only.
package_registry_non_implementation_conf: package_index is a declared per-artifact list scoped to a single package instance, not a cross-package registry.
package_integrity_computation_non_implem: checksum_or_digest is an optional declared string; no hashing or digest algorithm was added.
query_execution_non_implementation_confi: package_index_entry and included_artifact references are declared source locators/ids; no query-parameter, filter, or execution-trigger field exists.
graph_traversal_non_implementation_confi: Artifact references throughout the schema are flat, declared identifiers; no path-computation or traversal-order field exists.
advisory_integration_non_implementation_: advisory_intelligence_context_package appears only as a declared artifact_type reference category; no field invokes or configures Advisory Runtime or any Advisory subsystem.
inherited_defect_documented: is_phase_id_backward() in src/pcae/core/phase_reports.py compares letter-suffix branches as plain strings, causing 119AA to be misclassified as before 119Z during finalization; worked around with a documentation-only metadata reformat in 119AA, remains open for a future governance-repair phase.
